results.title: Procurement Price Analyst
results.description:
**Overview:**

MacTaggart Scott is seeking an enthusiastic and proactive Procurement Price Analyst who thrives on problem\-solving and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong time management, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complexity while building effective relationships with internal teams and external suppliers.


The role involves sourcing and pricing goods and services in line with the Procurement strategy, supporting major bids and contracts, and engaging with potential new suppliers. Additional responsibilities include conducting supplier and category analysis, ensuring compliance with company and customer requirements, supporting audits, and maintaining accurate data within our IFS system.


Initially, the successful candidate will work under close supervision to develop an understanding of defence procurement and company systems, with the aim of progressing to a more autonomous role over time.

**About us:**


MacTaggart Scott primarily supports the Naval Defence industry, providing complete solutions to customer needs from analysis of initial customer requirements, to design and manufacture, and right through to commissioning and through life support. Established in 1898, we are proud of our history and tradition but believe that sustainable competitive advantage can only be achieved through continuous improvement, investment, and a commitment to business excellence at every level within the company.

 **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities will include:**

* Managing all assigned bid and pre\-contract activities, ensuring timely resolution of enquiries.
* Coordinating with Category and Project teams to support bid requirements, including stock and major subcontracts.
* Assisting in the coordination and delivery of supplier onboarding activities.
* Maintaining up\-to\-date supplier documentation, including financial, quality, and environmental certifications.
* Proactively supporting the resolution of engineering requirements such as obsolescence, in collaboration with internal teams.
* Ensuring accurate maintenance of costing data in the ERP system and proper recording of supplier quotations.
* Developing and maintaining supplier relationships, seeking extended pricing validity and exploring innovative solutions to meet business needs.
* Supporting the full procurement lifecycle—from need identification and sourcing (RFQs) to contract placement, management, and delivery.
* Collaborating cross\-functionally to address supply chain challenges, including quote compliance, sustainable sourcing, and cost efficiency.
* Assisting in ensuring contractual terms align with customer requirements and flow\-downs, minimising and managing risk to MTS.
* Supporting the delivery of improved ESG outcomes through strategic sourcing activities.
* Identifying and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to enhance departmental performance.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Previous bid / estimating process experience.
* Supply chain principles and techniques.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
* Effective communication skills (written, oral and presentation).
* Previous experience in use of ERP systems.
* Competency in MS Office, including Word, Excel, Project, and PowerPoint.
* Be able to work positively and collaboratively with the wider stakeholder community, both internal and external.
* Good standard of general education / CIPS Level 3\.
* Be able to pro\-actively and effectively prioritise and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment and deliver results.
* Have self\-discipline, motivation, the ability to organise your workload and overcome problems as they arise.

**The successful candidate must hold or be able to meet the appropriate Security Clearance as required.**

**Desirable Requirements:**

* Background in defence related procurement, in particular marine based products.
* Use of Bills of Materials (BOM) and Product Requirements Document (PRD).
* Full membership of Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply (MCIPS).

  

**Benefits** **Your future at MacTaggart Scott – What we offer**

* As part of our Healthy Work\-Life Balance employees can choose between a 4\- or 5\-day working week. Allowing you to fit work around your priorities and personal life, not the other way round.
* We offer flexible working hours between 07:00 and 19:00, and core hours of 09:30 – 15:30\.
* Our leave policy brings together leave entitlements which include annual leave, paid parental leave, military reservist leave, plus more.
* We will provide you with a supportive and engaging environment where you can grow your career, with a dedicated Learning and Development team.
* We’re committed to your wellbeing with access to our comprehensive online wellbeing program, Employee Assistance Programme, and an onsite nurse to support you when needed.
* Enjoy the convenience of an onsite canteen, free parking, and a secure cycle\-to\-work scheme to make your daily routine easier.
* We also offer a generous company pension plan, exclusive employee discounts, and free flu vaccinations to help you stay healthy.
* In addition, our comprehensive health \& wellbeing programme is here to support you, along with life insurance for peace of mind and sick pay to help you when you need it most.

results.title: User Experience Designer, Full Time, Permanent
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
results.description:
**About BR\-DGE**



BR\-DGE is an award\-winning FinTech founded in Edinburgh, powered by a high\-performing, remote\-first team across the UK and beyond. Our platform gives e\-commerce and technology businesses the freedom and flexibility to redefine how they handle payments.



Since 2018, we’ve been pioneers in payment orchestration, enabling enterprise brands to optimise their infrastructure and create frictionless digital experiences. From travel giants to household retail names, our global customer base is growing fast, supported by world\-class partners like Visa and Worldpay.



The journey so far has been incredible, but we’re just getting started. We are looking for exceptional talent to join us as we level up our engineering maturity.

 **About this role**



At BR\-DGE, we champion an inclusive, engineering\-led approach to quality. Our Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) role is a position dedicated to architecting, building, and scaling our automated testing infrastructure and quality tooling. You will enable our teams to ship high quality software frequently and with total confidence by providing them with powerful, scalable testing tools and robust frameworks.



This is not a traditional QA or "sign off" testing role. You will not sit at the end of a delivery pipeline manually validating tickets or acting as a gatekeeper.



Instead, you are a core engineer. You will own the technical design, development, and evolution of our centralised automation frameworks and infrastructure. Your primary impact will be delivered through engineering systemic solutions that allow development teams to own their own quality and deploy safely.

 **What****you’ll****be doing**


* **Framework Architecture and Engineering**: Design and build automation frameworks, covering Integration, Contract, E2E, and Performance / Load testing. Be informed and opinionated on what good looks like for Unit and Component tests.
* **Tooling and Infrastructure Development**: Build, maintain, and scale internal testing tools, libraries, and test data management utilities that streamline the development lifecycle for all engineering teams.
* **CI / CD Optimisation**: Engineer and manage fast, reliable, CI native pipelines. Implement advanced, parallelised quality gates and automated feedback loops directly into the deployment infrastructure to eliminate manual intervention.
* **Architectural Testability**: Analyse system architecture and cloud native topologies to suggest and implement improvements that enhance system testability and quality.
* **Production Quality**: Build out monitoring, logging, and alerting tooling and standards. Translate incident postmortem findings into concrete, automated safeguards and process improvements.
* **Metrics and Diagnostics**: Implement and track quality metrics to diagnose system bottlenecks, using data to drive targeted performance and reliability enhancements across our frameworks.
* **Mentoring and Engineering Maturity**: Proactively drive forward the organisation wide quality strategy, building and designing our testing ecosystem, and mentoring software engineers. Act as a thought leader to coach development teams, championing 'quality first' design to improve delivery speed and move the needle on engineering maturity.

  

  

**Wh****at****we’re****looking for**



This role is for an engineer who is passionate about infrastructure, code quality, and framework design. We are looking for a technical specialist who thrives on solving complex automation challenges and building scalable software systems rather than writing and executing test scripts.

 **Essential Experience**


* **Advanced Software Engineering Fundamentals**: Deep proficiency in Java, TypeScript, or similar modern languages, with extensive recent experience operating as a core technical SDET.
* **Framework Design from Scratch**: A proven track record of designing, building, and scaling multi layered automation frameworks from the ground up (Integration, Contract, E2E, and Performance).
* **CI / CD and Pipeline Engineering**: Heavy hands\-on experience building, optimising, and maintaining CI / CD pipelines, with a focus on fast, parallelised execution and automated gates.
* **Cloud Native Architecture**: Deep understanding of distributed system design, microservices, and cloud native environments, with the ability to optimise them for logging, observability, and testability.
* **Root Cause Debugging:** Exceptional technical debugging skills across complex, distributed systems, with the ability to write robust automated regressions to address production vulnerabilities.
* **Technical Collaboration**: Ability to define technical standards, document framework architectures clearly, and collaborate with engineering teams to ensure seamless adoption of quality tooling.

  


**Nice to Have**


* Background experience as a Software Engineer.
* Experience implementing, capturing, and visualising DORA metrics automatically within deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with feature flagging frameworks and progressive delivery infrastructure.
* Experience in fintech, payments, or other high throughput environments where transactional integrity, security, and strict reliability are paramount.

  


**Why this role exists**



Our business is growing rapidly. We recognise that to achieve fast delivery and systemic quality, we need to move away from traditional testing bottlenecks. We need dedicated engineers who can build the robust, scalable automation infrastructure required to support continuous, hands\-off deployment. If you love writing code that empowers other systems and teams to run faster and safer, we want to talk to you.

  

**What we offer**



We provide a supportive, high\-growth environment where your impact is visible every day.


* **Financial:** Competitive salary and life insurance.
* **Time Off:** 33 days holiday (including public holidays) plus Birthday Leave.
* **Flexibility:** Remote\-first working culture that respects your other priorities.
* **Health:** Family private healthcare and an Employee Assistance Programme.
* **Growth:** A culture that champions career progression and direct investment in your learning and development.
* **Community:** Regular team events and socials to keep our remote team connected.

  


**Ready to bridge the gap? Apply to be a BR\-DGE Builder today.**



At BR\-DGE, we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that our roles should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings and try to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.
